effects.label: Dead End Butcher - CRIT DMG
effects.description: When not in a Stunned state, Boss enemies gain 1 stack of All or Nothing every 6s, stacking up to 3 stacks. Each stach of All or Nothing increases the DMG dealt by the Boss enemy by 10%. When an Agent's attack hits an enemy, for each stack of All or Nothing the target has, CRIT DMG from the Agent's attacks increases by 25% and Attribute Anomaly DMG decreases by 15%. When an enemy enters a Stunned state, they gain 1 stack of All or Nothing. All or Nothing stacks will be reset when the enemy recovers from being Stunned.
effects.shortDescription: The Agent's CRIT DMG is increased by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.
